notes.title: v1.18.1315 - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Aside from fixes, the biggest update this patch is the new QOL Turn Point indicator for multi-turn cards like Six Shooter / Hookah etc.   Thanks everyone for your suggestions and bug reports!

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[list]
[*] FIX: card tilt status (sometimes not tilted - e.g. cloned card)
[*] FIX: White WIdow - retaliation was not firing
[*] FIX: Peace Edition - cards correctly remain in play after buff ability
[*] UI: unlock card panel - larger cards (fix class box text scaling issue)
[*] FIX: Double Jointed - audio cue channel fixed
[*] FIX: Clone Ability - no longer runs any 'increase turn point' abilities on cloned cards resulting in a cloned Hookah with 8 turns!
[*] FIX: The Retriever - fix single use ability + update description to indicate free card space required
[*] UX: Seeing Double - description updated with affect player side cards only
[*] UI/UX - new turn point indicator next to Move Cost icon if turn points > 1 (this affects cards like Hookah / Six Shooter)
[*] Limit FPS to 60 (save energy / GPU cycles)
[*] UI: updated leaf icons / images
[*] UI/UX: general tweaks and improvements like buttons / text / spelling
[/list]

[h2]IN THE WORKS[/h2]
[list]
[*] XP Steam Leaderboard
[*] New game options menu
[*] Reset Progress (clears XP / Progress)
[*] MORE BUD CARDS
[/list]

GLHF!

notes.title: 'Rollin Scoobies' - UPDATE v0.15.818
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/a0814999cbd286373f9707207c01f903699e062b.png[/img]

Thought I would move the "early access cheats" as optional top right.  The game really is more fun with the challenge of earning wins to unlock cards... as well as fighting through the levels. 

The "one of each" mode lets you play all cards, and until the AI improves more - is a great way to grab some creds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/8d45eb1b10483c717b347fbc9eb488a440df6502.png[/img]

Sort of in the middle of a 'font change' atmo... having some issues with font 'jaggies' and working out how to sort in UE4...

Some new card "art" added for:
The Blues
That Jazz
The Longhair
Squeeky Clean
The Bass Player

I also added a sound loop for when the Main Menu loads = it's randomly picks a sound loop cue from the game and plays it.

Hope you are all having fun!

notes.title: Crazy Cool Update - v0.15.750
notes.notes:
The 'One of Each' game mode is currently my favourite way to play the game... + you can easily milk the AI for tons of CRED and XP.... lol.

===================

[b]NEW UI / OPTIONS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/2f7f92790e03d7a00ff0e82616a5ff5dc26f2b4c.png[/img]

We have added 'speedrun' and 'de-grinder' options in the form of:

a +1,000,000 XP Button
a +1,000,000 CRED Button
a RESET PLAYER button

The new RESET PLAYER button sets CRED to $0, XP to 0, and Level to 1. All Player Custom decks are also deleted. (load / save / reset a little wonky - working on bugs ASAP!)

Games Played and Games Won stats are are not reset.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/fb02456a8f01e52a69e7a1598df6825e343be9eb.png[/img]

The 'One of Each' game mode is a simple toggle switch to turn it on and off before a game.
